claim: At revision c844a467cf7f2503819b655f4d6ceaef91056c40, include/aspose/email/foss/cfb/cfb_reader.hpp line 28 declares a member function named header() whose return type is the struct header, which GCC 12, 13, 14 and 15 reject, so nine translation units fail to compile; Clang 18.1.3 and 22.1.8 accept it.
suggested_issue_title: cfb_reader::header() declaration "changes meaning of 'header'"; the library does not compile with GCC 12-15
suggested_issue_body:
repository-presenter's validation pipeline (BC-02) recorded this while re-verifying `aspose-email-foss/Aspose.Email-FOSS-for-Cpp`; it was then reproduced independently against the live default-branch head `c844a467cf7f2503819b655f4d6ceaef91056c40` on 2026-10-09T21:35Z.

## Summary

`cfb_reader.hpp:28` declares `[[nodiscard]] const header& header() const noexcept;` inside class `cfb_reader`. The name `header` is first used as the struct type and then re-declared as a member function of the same class. GCC diagnoses this as an error, so the default CMake build does not complete.

## Environment

- Revision `c844a467cf7f2503819b655f4d6ceaef91056c40` (default branch `master`)
- `ubuntu:24.04` with g++-12, g++-13 (13.3.0), g++-14 (14.2.0); Docker images `gcc:14` (14.4.0) and `gcc:15` (15.3.0); clang 18.1.3 and `silkeh/clang:latest` (22.1.8); cmake 3.28-3.31, ninja; `CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17` as set by the repository

## Steps to reproduce

```sh
git clone https://github.com/aspose-email-foss/Aspose.Email-FOSS-for-Cpp
cd Aspose.Email-FOSS-for-Cpp && git checkout c844a467cf7f2503819b655f4d6ceaef91056c40
docker run --rm -v "$PWD":/src ubuntu:24.04 bash -c "apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y -qq cmake ninja-build g++-13 && cmake -S /src -B /tmp/b -G Ninja -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER=g++-13 && cmake --build /tmp/b"
```

## Actual result

```
include/aspose/email/foss/cfb/cfb_reader.hpp:28:33: error: declaration of 'const aspose::email::foss::cfb::header& aspose::email::foss::cfb::cfb_reader::header() const' changes meaning of 'header' [-Wchanges-meaning]
   28 |     [[nodiscard]] const header& header() const noexcept;
include/aspose/email/foss/cfb/cfb_reader.hpp:28:25: note: used here to mean 'struct aspose::email::foss::cfb::header'
```
Translation units that fail: `cfb_reader.cpp`, `cfb_document.cpp`, `msg_document.cpp`, `mapi_message.cpp`, `eml_message_mapper.cpp`, `msg_reader.cpp`, `msg_writer.cpp`, `tests/test_cfb.cpp`, `tests/test_msg.cpp`.

Compiler matrix: g++ 12 FAIL (`-fpermissive` wording), g++ 13.3 FAIL, g++ 14.2/14.4 FAIL, g++ 15.3 FAIL; clang 18.1.3 PASS, clang 22.1.8 PASS.

## Where in the repository

- `include/aspose/email/foss/cfb/cfb_reader.hpp:28`
- `include/aspose/email/foss/cfb/header.hpp:11` (`struct header`)
